doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: His cousin pianist Adam Cato
summary: Pasley says Adam Cato of San Diego is his cousin, a versatile pianist who made many records, and the interviewer asks where to find him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. But, um, yeah, I got a cousin down here in San Diego named Adam Cato. He's a piano player. He's your cousin?

Yeah. Adam Cato is your cousin? Yeah. Is he older than you? No. I'm older than him. Is he still living? Yeah. Is he living? Sure. Yeah, but I heard so much talk about him, and I thought he was an old-time legend. No, he's not that old. Uh, do you have his address? I think I got it in that book somewhere. Do I have?
Cato? Yeah. I don't know, he was here not too long ago, then he was here at all.
Adam Cato? Yeah. And you know Jimmy Cato? Yeah, my first cousin. Yeah. Is he a brother of Adam, or?
That's one of the people who can't ever call him.
He's cousin. Yeah, he's dead. Oh, Adam is a cousin of Jimmy? Yeah. Oh, Jimmy is dead. Jimmy's dead. And do you know Big Cato? That's Big Cato, Jimmy. Yeah. Yeah, yeah. There are so many Cato.
His mother and my mother's were sisters.
Oh, man.
And he was more a blues player, I think. Yeah, he could play most anything, but nobody could beat Adam's playing. Yeah.
Does he still play?
Huh? Sure. Does he play? Down San Diego.
San Diego.
He lived in San Diego. Could you find his address?
This would be... Great. Yeah.
Where did you hear about Adam Cato?
Oh, all the way around. Sweet Williams told me and in New Orleans.
Did he play Barrowman Stone?
Yeah. Red Toots told me. He can play any style.

Yeah. But I tell you what, he can play classical music. Oh, yeah. He's just a good musician. Yeah. He's just a good period. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He made some records with Jimmy Noon I think. Yeah. Yeah. In Chicago. Yeah. Has Adam ever recorded?
Yeah but I don't know who he recorded with. He made a whole lot of recordings. Down in San Diego he made some somewhere up in Ohio.
Has Adam ever recorded?

Yeah, but I don't know who he recorded with. He made a whole lot of recordings. Down in San Diego he made some somewhere up in Ohio. He was in Springfield, Ohio for a while. He had a, they had an outfit. When I was with Joe Liggins he had some outfit. He had made quite a few records then. I don't, I can't call all those records he made. Just like me, I can't call all the records I made. I must have made a thousand. If I made one I must have made a thousand.
